comparison.objective: Install a rack rail versus unlatch and swing open a spring-plunger panel.
comparison.physical_skill: Two-pair spring-prong insertion, telescoping alignment and fastening versus retracting one plunger and rotating a hinged panel.
comparison.success_condition: Level self-supporting rail with correct screws versus panel opening angle without cabinet or latch damage.
comparison.reason: A shared spring-latch primitive is insufficient: the candidate tests staged insertion and retained structural attachment, while this record tests release and opening. Candidate force limits are missing.
